name: Liaoning Fu-An Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd
summary: Liaoning Fu-An Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd is a key manufacturer and supplier specializing in steel castings for a variety of technical and industrial equipment applications. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of cast components, including high/medium pressure inner and outer cylinders, cubic slag tanks, ton archways, partition covers and sleeves, PAC MA servomotor cylinder heads, cranks, suction ring cavities, tugboats, bearing seats, TW blades, baishan leafs, guide vanes, runner hubs, lower ring bands, crowns, steam seal bodies, elbows, frames, wheels, and bogies. Beyond its core casting operations, Liaoning Fu-An Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd also delivers advanced integrated unit control systems, industrial gas turbine generator sets, standalone gas turbines, and various other specialized equipment. Established in 2004, the company is headquartered in Anshan, China.
